frontmatter.title: Your Writing is Your Fingerprint: The Brutal Science of Stylometry in Cybersecurity
frontmatter.subheading: It's not what you write, it's how you write it. Why your grammar, tics, and typos are an unmasking tool for hackers and spies.
frontmatter.excerpt: A brutally honest deep dive into stylometric analysis. Discover how cybersecurity experts use your writing style to unmask threat actors, de-anonymize data, and hunt bots, with real Python examples.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
